systemStatus.detail:
FRI AUG 21 4:05 AM PT RUN.

TOAST -- Thursday Aug 20 is NOT available. At 4:05 AM neither the group nightly email (~6:30 AM PT) nor the 229 W Montecito single-location Daily Performance Summary (~7:40 AM PT) had arrived. That is expected for a 4 AM run, not a fault. What DID land after yesterday's 7:20 AM run is the single-location detail for WEDNESDAY AUG 19, so that day is now fully backfilled and is the most recent complete picture. Wed Aug 19: net $3,940.90, gross $4,367.50 (note: the authoritative gross is $4,367.50 -- the group email's $4,192.50 was only the sales-category subtotal), 179 guests, 134 orders, 137 checks, avg check $28.77, avg per guest $22.02. Versus same day last week (Wed Aug 12: net $5,014.42, 193 guests, 121 orders, avg check $39.48): net -21.4%, gross -16.3%, guests -7.3%, orders +10.7%. Same shape as reported yesterday -- more tickets, much smaller ones. Versus the 4-week Wednesday average, net was -21.1%.

THE NEW DETAIL WORTH ACTING ON -- discounts. The full summary puts Wed Aug 19 discounts at $426.60, not the $251.60 derived yesterday. That is +106.7% vs SDLW ($206.43) and +153.3% vs the 4-week average ($168.39), and it is 9.8% of gross. The concentration is striking: Expresso Service took $196.90 of discounts against $396.75 gross, landing at $199.85 net -- roughly half the line comped away. Food took $199.20 and Dinner $184.90. If there is a standing espresso promo or a comp habit at the coffee bar, this is where the margin is going. Voids were $93.00 across 9 items / 5 orders, essentially flat vs SDLW ($89.00) and unremarkable. Refunds $0. Gift cards: $175.00 gross fully offset by $175.00 discount, netting $0 in deferred sales.

LABOR -- 29.5% of net, up from Tuesday's 25.0% and above the 4-week average of 25.0%. But the dollars moved the other way: hourly labor cost was $1,164.36, DOWN 27.7% from SDLW's $1,611.04 and only 6.6% below the 4-week average. The percentage deteriorated because net sales fell harder than payroll did. This is a sales problem showing up in a labor ratio, not overstaffing.

DAYPARTS (Wed Aug 19) -- Dinner $2,575.85 net / 65.3%, $39.63 per order. Lunch $1,165.20 net / 29.5%, $33.29 per order. Expresso Service $199.85 net / 5.0%, $5.55 per order. Revenue centers: Dining Room $2,360.30 (59.8%), Patio $569.25 (14.4%), Front Patio $470.00 (11.9%), Back Room $324.00 (8.2%), Espresso Bar $217.35 (5.5%). Categories: Food $2,243.05 (56.9%, 149 items), Liquor $704.00 (17.8%, 58), Draft Beer $440.50 (11.1%, 53), Espresso $217.35 (5.5%, 45), Wine $198.00 (5.0%, 25).

SLING -- Friday Aug 21's daily report had not arrived at 4:05 AM (it lands ~7:00 AM PT), so today's roster is not yet confirmed. Last received is Thursday Aug 20: 8 employees / 8 shifts / 35.75 scheduled hours / 0 uncovered / 0 overtime / 0 off, kitchen covered by Rafael Patricio (Cook). Roster: Rafael Patricio (Cook), Sarah Palmer (Barista), Tony Rincon (Bartender), Christine Vargas (Server), Harmony Willson (Bartender), James Hernadez (Server), Bri Kelley (Server), Julianna Ornelas (Barback).

REVIEWS -- BOTH Google Business Profiles were opened live in Chrome this run and the Unreplied tab was read on-screen for each. THE BREWHOUSE (4.5 stars / 526 reviews): 1 unanswered -- sergio salazar, 5-star, 5 days ago. BREWHOUSE COFFEE (5.0 stars / 5 reviews): 1 unanswered -- Geoff Lay, 5-star, 6 days ago, Horchata Latte. The Donald Clay botulism 1-star is absent for a third consecutive live check and continues to be treated as removed. Draft replies for sergio and Geoff are written and await Joal's approval -- nothing has been posted, per standing policy.

GOOGLE ADS -- Email-only check this run; the dashboard was not scraped. Two 'report is ready' notifications in the last 24h (Brewhouse Daily Campaign Report and Campaign performance, both Aug 20) plus one marketing best-practices blast. Zero disapprovals, zero billing or suspension notices.
